name: Uday Kumar
headline: Technology Lead | Software Engineer (7+ Y Exp) | NIT Trichy
about: I'm a Software Engineer and Technical Lead with 7+ years of experience architecting scalable distributed systems and mission-critical enterprise applications. Proficient in Java, Spring Boot, React, Node.js, and GraphQL, I specialize in end-to-end software delivery, robust API design, and performance optimization. My track record spans leading engineering teams and building high-impact platforms, including Trading APIs and Billing solutions, from concept to production. Holding an MCA from NIT Trichy, I bring a strong analytical foundation and a passion for technical strategy, mentorship, and solving complex engineering challenges.

bullets: Spearheaded the end-to-end design and development of the Trade API, contributing to over 90% of the project.
Designed and developed the pagination feature in Trade API.
Developed and integrated a Trade Ignite Cache to enhance Trade API performance by over 90%.
Designed and developed the traffic routing system to distribute API load to TradeQueryServer and TradePostingServer.
Developed and deployed over 50 features and bug fixes for trading applications.
Provided support for trading servers for over 50 weeks.
Played a key role in designing and developing the Project Requests (Portfolio Management) module, with 60% involvement in the UI and 20% in the backend.
Designed and developed the Project's Bill Plan feature, contributing equally to both UI and backend (50% each).
Involved in Billing Rate UI, Auto Reference Number, and Tax Profile feature development.

projects.name: Trade API
projects.description: Trade API is a REST API offering endpoints to retrieve, filter, and manage trade data. Users can fetch trades using specific filters or criteria, and use post, batch post, cancel, and batch cancel endpoints to create, update, or cancel trades.

projects.name: Transactional Trade Cache
projects.description: Transactional Trade Cache is a caching technique that boosts Trade API performance, reducing retrieve API response time from 100 ms to 1 ms and efficiently handling over 1 million requests daily.

projects.name: Project Portfolio Management
projects.description: Project Portfolio Management (PPM) is a solution designed to streamline project costing and management, enabling organizations to deliver projects on time and within budget. It provides real-time visibility into project and program costs by tracking time spent by resources.

projects.name: Project Bill Plans & Tax Profile
projects.description: Project Bill Plans is designed to manage project billing with various plan options, such as daily or recurring schedules. The Tax Profile feature allows you to apply the appropriate taxes to project billing for different clients and regions.
